_comment: Hardware inventory of RuView sensing nodes. Source of truth for node_id ↔ MAC ↔ position. IPs may change with DHCP; that is intentional — node_id (provisioned into NVS for the S3s, set via systemd env for the C6) is the canonical identity used by the sensing-server.

2.ld2410_status: unit declared bad 2026-06-11 after exhaustive TX/RX x baud testing; new LD2410s arriving 2026-06-12
2.role_pending: long-range presence + range via LD2410 once a working unit is wired
2.notes: Re-flashed 2026-06-11 to ESPHome to host an LD2410. The original LD2410 wiring incident damaged the radar (not the S3 — the S3 boots and runs ESPHome cleanly). Pi systemd drop-in keeps RUVIEW_LD2410_* env vars commented out until a working LD2410 is attached, at which point the bridge picks it up via MQTT with zero further config.

4.transport: MQTT to mosquitto on Pi (127.0.0.1:1883), topic prefix ruview-c6-radar
4.role: authoritative source for presence, range, HR, BR (radar-grade, not heuristic)
4.notes: Restored 2026-06-11. The Pi-side c6_radar_bridge subscribes to MQTT and synthesises ADR-039 vitals packets stamped with node_id=4, set via systemd drop-in /etc/systemd/system/ruview-sensing.service.d/c6-radar.conf env RUVIEW_C6_NODE_ID=4. Earlier collision with node 1 (when the env was =1) clobbered the west S3's CSI slot half the time.

spare._comment: USB-to-serial chip IDs of the three currently-tethered nodes — for re-locating them physically.
